# DNR's
DNR's may be issued to criminals by the current CMP, XO, CO or acting commander. DNR's issued to criminals may only be done so in the event of: - Attempted escape of confinement by any means. - A authorized execution has been fullfilled
DNR's may also be issued to personnel by the current CMO. DNR's issued by the CMO may only be done so in the event of: - Request of the individual due to religious or other sufficient cause. - Biological Infections. - Extensive tissue or biological damage, beyond repair or treatment.
DNR's require the corpse of the individual to be placed within a body bag with a note attached, reading the name of the DNR, their rank if applicable, the reason and the personnel to issue the DNR.
[italic]OOC Note: DNR's are a form of execution and should be used sparringly, at the request of a individual or those who have consistently violated the above events, such as consitently attempting to escape confinement and not valuing their life. Abuse of DNR's can result in administrator intervention and punishment. [/italic]
